briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 launch intensifies AGI race as compute shortages bite

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid regulatory scrutiny. Compute constraints and safety concerns dominate strategic discussions. Global investment remains robust with new entrants challenging US dominance.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with enhanced reasoning while Anthropic counters with Claude 4. Google DeepMind deploys Gemini 3 and Meta open-sources Llama 4. xAI scales Grok-3 training on custom clusters.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. Regulators push for mandatory red-teaming as new exploits surface. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell in volume while TSMC ramps 2nm capacity. Microsoft and Google announce new hyperscale regions dedicated to AI training. Energy demands trigger grid strain in multiple regions.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent security protocols like dynamic dialects become the standard for preventing cascading failures in autonomous systems?
